description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search prime federal contract and grant awards from USAspending.gov attributed to tracked space companies: obligated dollars, awarding agency and sub-agency, award type, dates, PSC/NAICS space-coding and direct source URLs. Filter by company slug, agency, dates, dollar floor and space-coded-only.

agency.description: Awarding agency substring, e.g. "NASA" or "Department of Defense".

include_vehicles.description: Include IDV contract vehicles (excluded by default to avoid double-counting orders).

limit.description: How many awards to return (1 to 25).

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum obligated amount in US dollars.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

space_coded_only.description: Only return awards coded by the government as space work (PSC/NAICS).

name: federal_awards_search
title: Federal awards search
